candidates.reason: Unit tests for scrapy.utils.misc.build_from_crawler(), the helper the PR generalizes internally; behaviour of __init__ vs from_crawler and the None-return TypeError is asserted here.

Crawler._apply_settings is where STATS_CLASS, LOG_FORMATTER, REQUEST_FINGERPRINTER_CLASS and EXTENSIONS are currently built by direct constructor/from_crawler calls; generalizing them to build_from_crawler changes this file's expectations about when those attributes exist.
Exercises Downloader construction (including a custom DOWNLOADER subclass) and direct-from-crawler component construction, both of which move to build_from_crawler().
ExecutionEngine builds the DOWNLOADER component with downloader_cls(crawler); the PR routes it through build_from_crawler(), which this file covers via a custom failing downloader and close paths.
Scraper construction (its SpiderMiddlewareManager and ITEM_PROCESSOR handling) is the internal component wiring that the PR switches to build_from_crawler().

STATS_CLASS is currently instantiated as load_object(...)(crawler); generalizing to build_from_crawler() makes an optional from_crawler() classmethod on a custom collector effective, which these tests define.
LOG_FORMATTER is built with a direct lf_cls.from_crawler(self) call; switching to build_from_crawler() changes the contract for custom log-formatter classes covered here.

ITEM_PROCESSOR is built via itemproc_cls.from_crawler(crawler); generalizing it to build_from_crawler() allows a custom pipeline manager without a from_crawler() classmethod, exactly the variants this module defines.
Covers SpiderMiddlewareManager construction (currently SpiderMiddlewareManager.from_crawler in Scraper), the manager the PR builds through build_from_crawler().
Covers DownloaderMiddlewareManager construction from the Downloader, which changes from a direct from_crawler() call to build_from_crawler().
RobotsTxtMiddleware instantiates ROBOTSTXT_PARSER with a direct parser.from_crawler(crawler, b"") call; generalizing to build_from_crawler() affects parser construction covered here.
Tests MiddlewareManager.from_crawler() and per-middleware construction, the shared helper code path the PR generalizes for all middleware managers and extension managers.

SPIDER_LOADER_CLASS is built with loader_cls.from_settings(settings.frozencopy()), the remaining settings-based construction that a crawler-based build_from_crawler() generalization would touch; custom loader behaviour is asserted here.
StatsMailer builds MailSender via a direct MailSender.from_crawler(crawler) call, one of the internal from_crawler() call sites replaced by build_from_crawler().
MemoryUsage also constructs MailSender through MailSender.from_crawler(crawler); the generalized construction path is exercised by this extension's crawl tests.
